1. It becomes a threshold rule on $x$; choose $\tau$ so the class-$0$ right-tail mass equals $\alpha$.  
2. $\mathrm{FPR}=P(X>\tau\mid Y=0)$; $\mathrm{TPR}=P(X>\tau\mid Y=1)$.  
3. One threshold $\tau$ (one operating point / trade-off).  
4. A random (coin-flip) classifier — chance performance.  
5. Area under the ROC; ideal AUC is $1$.
